proposal.rule: A curve change that raises depth NaN and drops fill is not a usable fix for the 24 cm residual. The holes that grew on the leading rings, plus the top and bottom bands already present, are f_over_gate: lining radii and theta fall outside the denoise window and become depth holes, which cuts fill. Widen the radial gate and the theta gate. Do not repeat degree 3, ransac 0.92, or the oblique-threshold/gap relaxation. Do not move slice spacing or the vertical Hough threshold; ring count is already exact.
proposal.rationale: mask_r_low 2.73 and mask_r_high 3.10 open the radial window inside [2.7, 3.0] and [2.9, 3.15] without sitting on the stops, so leading-ring points the 24 cm residual pushes just outside the band can stay as lining. mask_theta_low 1.25 and mask_theta_high 18.0 likewise open the circumferential window inside [1.0, 2.5] and [15.0, 19.0], aimed at the top and bottom hole bands rather than at a full-open gate. Unfolding and detection are omitted: the cubic plus tighter RANSAC increased NaN, and lowering the oblique vote to 30 with maxLineGap 40 did not extend joints onto the left four rings or move the prompts off a single Y. SAM template keys stay at the start; the development overlays that retuned them jointly cut fill.
